_meta.description: Hand-curated WordPress plugin vulnerability database for offline matching. Versions follow semver-ish comparison rules used by ver_lt().
_meta.source: Public advisories (Wordfence, WPScan, NVD). Not exhaustive — update as needed.

vulns.title: File Manager < 6.9: unauthenticated RCE via elFinder
vulns.remediation: Update to 6.9+ immediately. Audit /wp-content/uploads for backdoors (look for *.php files, especially under uploads/wp-file-manager-pro/).

vulns.title: wp-file-manager < 6.9: unauthenticated RCE
vulns.remediation: Update to 6.9+ immediately and audit uploads for webshells.

vulns.title: Contact Form 7 < 5.7.1: unrestricted file upload
vulns.remediation: Update CF7 to 5.7.1+. Audit uploads for executable content.

vulns.title: Duplicator < 1.4.7: backup leak via /wp-content/backups-dup-lite/
vulns.remediation: Update Duplicator to 1.4.7+ and rotate DB credentials (backups contain wp_users).

vulns.title: WPForms Lite < 1.7.5.4: stored XSS in form entries
AIOSEO < 4.1.5.3: privilege escalation + SQLi
vulns.remediation: Update AIOSEO to 4.1.5.3+. Rotate admin credentials.

vulns.title: Jetpack < 9.8: privilege escalation in REST endpoints
Ultimate Member < 2.6.7: unauthenticated privilege escalation
vulns.remediation: Update Ultimate Member to 2.6.7+ immediately. Audit users in wp_users with 'wp_capabilities' = administrator that you didn't create.

vulns.title: Essential Addons < 5.7.2: unauthenticated privilege escalation
vulns.remediation: Update Essential Addons to 5.7.2+. Rotate admin credentials.

vulns.title: Forminator < 1.24.7: unrestricted file upload
vulns.remediation: Update Forminator to 1.24.7+ and audit uploads.

vulns.title: LiteSpeed Cache < 6.4.1: privilege escalation
vulns.remediation: Update LiteSpeed Cache to 6.4.1+. Rotate admin credentials.

vulns.title: WP Automatic < 3.92.1: unauthenticated SQLi
vulns.remediation: Update WP Automatic to 3.92.1+. Audit for new admin users.

vulns.title: Royal Elementor Addons < 1.3.79: unauthenticated arbitrary file upload
vulns.remediation: Update Royal Elementor Addons to 1.3.79+ and audit uploads for webshells.

vulns.title: WP Mail SMTP < 3.7.0: email leak via debug log
